description: Search ClinicalTrials.gov studies by condition, intervention or any words, optionally only recruiting ones: NCT id, title, status, phase, conditions, interventions, sponsor, enrollment, start and completion dates, number of locations and countries, and a link. From the ClinicalTrials.gov API (US National Library of Medicine). Information only, not medical advice. Use to find trials for a condition or drug. Example: condition=type 1 diabetes. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

condition.description: Condition or disease, e.g. type 1 diabetes

status.description: recruiting, active, completed or all (default recruiting)

name: gov_clinical_trials
title: Clinical trials search: ClinicalTrials.gov studies
